title: Cavern Maw
description: A sub-register 808 voice that breathes alien life: noise bleeds into the body as an FM index swells, while euclidean tremolo gating chops it into a pulsing throb. Over 32 cycles the pitch envelope, vowel formant and cavernous delay sweep through each other so the loop never resettles.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 [eb1 f1] g0 c1>(<5 3 7>,8)/2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1.5, 9)).fmh("<0.5 1 1.5 2>/4")
    .noise(sine.slow(23).range(0, 0.35))
    .penv("<12 0 -7 0>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.09)
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 2200)).resonance(14).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.006).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vowel("<a o u>/3")
    .tremolosync("<4 8 6>/8").tremolodepth(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.9))
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .shape(0.32)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).crush(6))
    .delay("0.4:0.5:0.65").room(0.8).orbit(2)
    .gain(0.9)
)
